This test checks that completion gives correct completion when using variables.

-- flags --
-ignore_extra_diags

-- go.mod --
module golang.org/lsptests/variable

go 1.18

-- settings.json --
{
	"completeUnimported": false
}

-- variable.go --
package variable

func _(){
	var (
		left  string //@item(varLeft, "left", "string", "var")
		right string //@item(varRight, "right", "string", "var")
	)

	ri //@complete(" //", varRight)
	left, ri //@complete(" //", varLeft, varRight)
}
